user.title: Set up Reolink Clip Cache
user.description: Cached clips are stored privately under your configuration folder and served over an authenticated URL, so they are never publicly readable.

data_description.cameras: Leave empty to cache every Reolink camera.
data_description.event_types: Motion is deliberately not offered: it fires far too often to be worth caching.
data_description.stream: Low resolution is much smaller and caches faster. If every download fails, try the other one - some NVRs will not serve downloads for one of the streams.
data_description.cache_days: Clips older than this are deleted automatically.
data_description.max_cache_size_mb: Once the cache exceeds this, the oldest clips are removed first.
data_description.sweep_minutes: A detection also triggers a check shortly after the event ends.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Reolink media source: {error}
error.no_cameras: No Reolink cameras with playback support were found. Check that the Reolink integration is set up and that your NVR has a working hard disk.

purge_cache.name: Purge cache
purge_cache.description: Applies the retention limits immediately, deleting cached clips that are older than the configured number of days or that push the cache over its size ceiling.

refresh_cache.name: Refresh cache
refresh_cache.description: Re-discovers Reolink cameras and reconciles the clip index against the files on disk. Use this after renaming a camera or adding one to the NVR.

sweep_now.name: Sweep now
sweep_now.description: Looks for new recordings straight away instead of waiting for the next scheduled sweep. Also useful for backfilling earlier days.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera key to sweep. Leave empty to sweep every camera.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back to sweep, counting today.
